package main

import (
	"container/heap"

	"example.com/lib/v2"
)

type IntHeap []int

func (h IntHeap) Len() int { return len(h) }

func (h *IntHeap) Push(x any) { *h = append(*h, x.(int)) }

func (h *IntHeap) Pop() any { return 0 }

func (h IntHeap) Unused() {}

var Left, Right = 1, 2

func main() {
	h := &IntHeap{}
	heap.Push(h, 3)
	lib.Open(Left)
}
